question: Aubrie attacks with a [Scrounger of Souls]. Nico blocks with a [Barony Vampire]. How much life does Aubrie gain?
answer_gold: 3. Lifelink means that damage the creature deals also causes its controller to gain that much life. Scrounger of Souls deals damage equal to its power to the Barony Vampire in combat, regardless of the Barony Vampire's toughness.

question: Autumn casts [Bishop of Binding], exiling Nina's [Nantuko Monastery] that is currently a creature. On their next turn, they attack with the Bishop of Binding. What are its power and toughness after the trigger resolves?
answer_gold: 1/1. Bishop of Binding refers to "the exiled card", so it doesn't matter that it isn't currently a creature. However the Nantuko Monastery in exile has no power and toughness, so the Bishop of Binding gets +0/+0.

question: Andrew controls [Colfenor's Plans]. They want to cast [Backwoods Survivalists] and then suspend [Hypergenesis]. Can they?
answer_gold: No. A card may only be suspended if its owner could begin to cast it.

question: Nicholas controls [Bramble Elemental]. Adrienne casts [Confiscate], targeting the Bramble Elemental. Who gets the tokens?
answer_gold: Adrienne does. As soon as the Confiscate enters the battlefield, Adrienne controls the Bramble Elemental. The triggered ability of Bramble Elemental checks immediately afterwards, at which point it is controlled by Adrienne.

question: Allan controls [Living Inferno]. They activate it, targeting Nathaly's [Runeclaw Bear]. In response, Nathaly casts [Chemister's Trick], targeting the Living Inferno. How much damage will be dealt to Runeclaw Bear when the Living Inferno's ability resolves?
answer_gold: 8. Since Living Inferno divides its damage among multiple targets, Allan announces the division while activating the ability. It won't change later, even if Living Inferno's power changes.

question: Aspen controls a [Blood Tyrant] that they took control of from Briella using [Malevolent Whispers]. Aspen has 1 life. Cason casts [Volt Charge] targeting Aspen. After it resolves and Aspen loses the game, will Blood Tyrant get the +1/+1 counters?
answer_gold: No. As Aspen loses the game, the effect granting them control of Blood Tyrant ends, and it returns to Briella. "Loses the game" triggers use the game state immediately before they triggered to determine how that trigger is handled. Since Aspen controlled Blood Tyrant right before losing the game, the trigger would be placed onto the stack under their control. However Aspen is no longer in the game when the trigger would be placed onto the stack, so it never is.

question: Adriana controls [Blood Sun] and plays [Temple of Plenty]. What happens?
answer_gold:
Temple of Plenty will enter the battlefield untapped. Its enters-the-battlefield trigger will not trigger.

"Temple of Plenty enters the battlefield tapped" is a replacement effect. Since the Temple of Plenty loses that ability, it enters the battlefield as though that replacement effect doesn't exist. 

"When Temple of Plenty enters the battlefield..." is a triggered ability. Enters-the-battlefield triggered abilities check their trigger conditions immediately after the permanent enters the battlefield. Temple of Plenty does not have the ability at that time, so it does not trigger.

question: Asa controls a [Welding Jar] enchanted by Nala's [Curse Artifact]. In response to the trigger during Asa's upkeep, Nala casts [Word of Seizing] to take control of the Welding Jar. What happens as the trigger resolves?
answer_gold: Asa is dealt 2 damage. Sacrificing the Welding Jar is a cost. If the cost isn't paid, the default action of dealing 2 damage to Asa happens. Asa cannot sacrifice a permanent that they don't control.

question: Nico controls [Platinum Emperion]. Alexandra attacks with [Hopeful Eidolon], which Nico doesn't block. Does Alexandra gain life?
answer_gold:
Yes. Damage can have 0 or more results. Normally a creature with lifelink dealing damage to a player would have two results:

* Its controller gains that much life.
* The recipient of the damage loses that much life.

Platinum Emperion makes the second result impossible, so only the first occurs.

question: Ari casts [Leyline Invocation]. In response, Neil casts [Gather Specimens]. After everything resolves, Ari activates the second ability of [Homeward Path]. Who gains control of the token?
answer_gold: Ari does. Tokens are owned by the player that created them. Ari still created the token, regardless of under whose control it entered the battlefield.

question: Norah controls [Blood Sun]. Ari plays [Dark Depths] and then destroys the Blood Sun with [Sultai Charm]. What happens?
answer_gold: Dark Depths entered the battlefield with no ice counters, since it didn't have the ability that would cause it to enter with them. When Blood Sun is destroyed, Dark Depths triggers since it has no ice counters on it and creates a Marit Lage token.

question: Axel casts [Show and Tell]. Axel chooses to put [Rowan Treefolk] onto the battlefield, and Natalee chooses [Containment Priest]. What happens to the Rowan Treefolk?
answer_gold: It enters the battlefield. Both permanents from Show and Tell enter the battlefield at the same time. Containment Priest's replacement effect must exist before a creature enters the battlefield in order to affect it.

question: Addison controls [Grizzly Bears] paired with [Nearheath Pilgrim] and an unpaired [Elgaud Shieldmate]. They cast [Man-o'-War] and targets Grizzly Bears with its triggered ability. What are the legal pairings after all triggers have resolved?
answer_gold: Either no pairings or Man-o'-War with Elgaud Shieldmate. Nearheath Pilgrim's soulbond ability didn't trigger and when Elgaud Shieldmate's ability resolves, it can only be paired with the creature that caused it to trigger.

question: It is currently Addison's cleanup step, and Nola cast an [Emrakul, the Promised End] last turn, taking control of Addison's current turn. Who chooses what cards to discard to hand size?
answer_gold: Nola does. Cards are discarded to hand size before "this turn" and "until end of turn" effects wear off. Emrakul, the Promised End's effect is not a "this turn" or "until end of turn" effect in any case, so it lasts for the entire turn.

question: Aubrey controls a [Leaden Myr] with a +1/+1 counter. They cast [Rise of the Dark Realms], putting [Dracoplasm] and [Thief of Blood] onto the battlefield. Aubrey would like to sacrifice the Leaden Myr to Dracoplasm's ability. What are the power and toughness of both creatures after they have entered the battlefield?
answer_gold: Both Dracoplasm and Thief of Blood are 2/2. Since they are both entering the battlefield at the same time, their replacement effects take place at the same time. Thief of Blood removes the +1/+1 counter from Leaden Myr at the same time as Dracoplasm sacrifices it. Thief of Blood sees that 1 counter was removed and so enters the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter, while Dracoplasm looks at the Leaden Myr's last known information and sees that it was a 2/2 immediately before it left the battlefield.

question: Ally controls [Brood Keeper] enchanted by [Frenzied Rage]. They cast [Aura Finesse] targeting Frenzied Rage and Brood Keeper. Does Brood Keeper trigger?
answer_gold: No. Frenzied Rage was already attached to Brood Keeper, so it can't "become" attached again.

question: Naomi controls [Rhystic Study]. Ariel casts [The Day of the Doctor]. As Rhystic Study's trigger resolves, who makes their choice first? Does Naomi choose whether or not to draw a card, and if yes, Ariel may pay the mana to prevent it? Or does Ariel choose to pay the mana first, and if they don't, Naomi has the choice to draw a card?
answer_gold: Ariel chooses first.

question: Autumn and Nico are beginning the game and have just drawn 7 cards. Nico has a [Serum Powder] in their hand. Does Nico get to know whether Autumn is going to mulligan before deciding whether to use Serum Powder's ability?
answer_gold: Yes. Nico exiles their hand and draws 7 cards at the time they would normally declare if they are going to take a mulligan, which is after Autumn has made that decision.

question: Aubrey controls [Mairsil, the Pretender] and has [Celestial Enforcer] in exile with a cage counter on it. They activate [Quicksilver Elemental], targeting Mairsil, the Pretender. Does Quicksilver Elemental gain the activated abilities of Celestial Enforcer? If so, can they be activated more than once that turn?
answer_gold: Quicksilver Elemental does gain the activated abilities of Mairsil, the Pretender, but they can only be activated once per turn. Mairsil, the Pretender's instruction of "You may activate each of those abilities only once each turn" is an activation instruction that's added to each ability it gains, and Quicksilver Elemental retains all activation instructions on each ability that it gains.

question: Angela controls [Gavony Unhallowed] and [Rocco, Cabaretti Caterer], which is their commander. Angela sacrifices Rocco, Cabaretti Caterer to [Trading Post] and chooses to put it into their command zone. Does Gavony Unhallowed trigger?
answer_gold: Yes. Commanders do move to the graveyard when sacrificed. They may be put into the command zone when state-based actions are checked.

question: Amira controls a token that's a copy of [Greater Mossdog] created by [Quasiduplicate]. They cast [Dregs of Sorrow] to destroy Greater Mossdog. Can Amira dredge the token? If so, what happens?
answer_gold: The token is put into the graveyard just like any other permanent, and it has dredge while it's there. However Greater Mossdog can't leave the graveyard, so Amira can't choose to dredge it.

question: Ainsley controls [Amulet of Vigor] and plays [Rupture Spire]. Can they pay for the trigger with Rupture Spire?
answer_gold: Yes. When Ainsley plays Rupture Spire, it and Amulet of Vigor both trigger simultaneously. Ainsley can choose the order these go on the stack and have Rupture Spire untap before they is required to pay for Rupture Spire's ability.

question: Avery controls [Rest in Peace] and [Fresh Volunteers]. They cast [Hour of Revelation]. After that resolves, where will each card be?
answer_gold: Rest in Peace and Fresh Volunteers will be in exile and Hour of Revelation will be in the graveyard. Rest in Peace is creating a replacement effect that causes cards that would go to the graveyard to be put into exile instead. After Hour of Revelation has destroyed Rest in Peace, Hour of Revelation is put into the graveyard.

question: Aspen controls [Parallel Lives] and a [Caldera Hellion]. They cast [Rite of Replication] targeting the Caldera Hellion. Can Aspen apply the devour replacement effect before the Parallel Lives replacement effect, sacrificing 1 creature to have each token enter with a +1/+1 counter?
answer_gold: No. There are two replacement effects trying to apply to the original event of creating a Caldera Hellion: Caldera Hellion's own effect and Parallel Lives's effect. Caldera Hellion's effect applies to it entering the battlefield however, while Parallel Lives's effect applies to it being created, so Parallel Lives's effect must be applied first. After that is applied the original Caldera Hellion's effect doesn't exist anymore, but each of the new Caldera Hellions entering the battlefield has its own effect, which can now be applied individually.

question: Azariah, Beckham, and Caelan are playing a multiplayer game. Beckham controls [Stalking Leonin]. Azariah casts [Worst Fears] to take control of Beckham's next turn. After Beckham begins their turn, can Azariah see which player was chosen for the Stalking Leonin?
answer_gold: No. The choice was made as Stalking Leonin entered the battlefield, which already happened- it's no longer visible to Beckham. Azariah can choose to activate the ability (at which point all players will know who was chosen), but otherwise the choice is not visible to any player.

question: Averie casts [Living Death] while they control [Immortal Coil] and [Prizefighter Construct]. The only card in their graveyard is a [Lathnu Sailback]. Does Averie lose the game? If so, could they avoid this by countering Immortal Coil's trigger with [Stifle]?
answer_gold: Averie will lose the game unless they castStifle. The first step in Living Death's resolution is to exile all creature cards from graveyards. At this point, Immortal Coil will trigger because Averie has no cards in their graveyard. Although sacrificing Prizefighter Construct will ultimately put a creature card there before this trigger is put on the stack, it still will go on the stack and resolve.. Immortal Coil has a state trigger, therefore, there will only be one instance of this triggered ability on the stack. After Living Death resolves, Averie can Stifle Immortal Coil's ability and it won't be put on the stack again because they now have cards in their graveyard.

question: Anabella casts [False Dawn]. After it resolves, they tap a [Moonring Island] for mana. What color of mana does it produce?
answer_gold: {W}. Moonring Island's ability to add mana is controlled by Anabella.

question: Allison controls [Vernal Equinox] and casts [Hypothesizzle]. After discarding a card but before Hypothesizzle deals four damage to a creature, Allison casts [Radiant Scrollwielder]. Will Allison gain four life?
answer_gold:
No. Hypothesizzle has a reflexive trigger. Allison chooses to discard a card as part of the resolution of Hypothesizzle, which will cause Hypothesizzle to put a trigger on the stack after it resolves that will deal four damage to a creature. To determine whether Allison would gain life as the trigger resolves, the game checks Hypothesizzle as it last existed on the stack, at which point it did not have lifelink.

(Hypothesizzle in the graveyard also doesn't have lifelink as it's not an instant or a sorcery spell, but this doesn't matter due to the rules above.)

question: August controls [Essence of the Wild] and casts [Xantcha, Sleeper Agent]. What happens as it enters the battlefield?
answer_gold: It enters under Nico's control and doesn't become a copy of Essence of the Wild. As it enters the battlefield, there are two replacement effects trying to apply to that event. Since Xantcha, Sleeper Agent's effect changes under whose control it would enter, it needs to be applied first. Once it's been applied, it's now entering under Nico's control, and Essence of the Wild's effect doesn't apply to it.

question: Arlo casts [Zoetic Cavern] face-down. In response, Nico casts [Delay] targeting the face-down spell. What happens?
answer_gold: Just like for any other spell, Zoetic Cavern is countered, exiled face-up with three time counters and gains suspend. In Arlo's upkeep three turns later, they can play it as their land for the turn.

question: Axl controls [Immolation Shaman]. Nico taps [Jhessian Lookout] to crew [Sleek Schooner]. Does Immolation Shaman trigger?
answer_gold: Yes. Crew is an activated ability of an artifact ([702.122a]), and is not a mana ability. Therefore activating it satisfies the trigger condition on Immolation Shaman.

question: Alex owns a face-down [Blightsteel Colossus] in exile. Neil uses [Processor Assault] to put Blightsteel Colossus into Alex's graveyard. Where does Blightsteel Colossus move to?
answer_gold: The graveyard. Replacement effects must exist before the event in question in order to affect it. Blightsteel Colossus has no abilities in exile, so there is no replacement effect that would apply to it moving to the graveyard.

question: Avery attacks with a [Guile] that was turned face-down by [Ixidron], and Nelson blocks with [Jerrard of the Closed Fist]. Does Avery shuffle?
answer_gold:
Yes. By default, triggered abilities are checked immediately after the event in question to see if they should trigger. At that point, the Guile is face-up in the graveyard and has that ability.

(Guile's trigger does not fit the exception for "leaves-the-battlefield" triggers because it is a "from anywhere" trigger.)

question: Ahmad is on their second mulligan, down to five cards. When Ahmad goes to put cards on the bottom of their library, how many cards will they be putting on the bottom and in what order?
answer_gold: Ahmad will be putting two cards on the bottom of their library, and they will choose the order.

question: Aubrianna attacks with [Rockslide Elemental], which has 4 +1/+1 counters. Nelson blocks with [Tephraderm]. What happens to Rockslide Elemental in the first combat damage step?
answer_gold:
Tephraderm will trigger upon combat damage being dealt, and Rockslide Elemental will trigger as Tephraderm dies after SBAs are checked. Since there are now multiple triggers waiting to be placed on the stack, Aubrianna and Nelson will do so respectively in APNAP order.

Nelson's trigger will resolve first; Tephraderm deals 5 damage to Rockslide Elemental, which dies to lethal damage. Aubrianna's trigger resolves second and does nothing, since Rockslide Elemental is no longer on the battlefield.

question: Alden casts [Too Greedily, Too Deep] targeting [Arixmethes, Slumbering Isle], while Nico controls [Containment Priest]. What happens when Too Greedily, Too Deep resolves?
answer_gold: Arixmethes, Slumbering Isle will either enter the battlefield as a land, or it will be exiled, it's Alden's choice.There are two replacement effects applying to Arixmethes, Slumbering Isle as it enters the battlefield, its own ability that has it enter with counters, and Containment Priest's ability. The game takes into account how the permanent will exist on the battlefield for the purposes of determining whether certain replacement effects will apply to it. If Alden chooses to have Containment Priest apply first, Arixmethes, Slumbering Isle will be exiled. If they chooses to apply Arixmethes, Slumbering Isles ability first, it will enter the battlefield as a land, and Containment Priests ability won't apply.

question: Asa attacks with [Tephraderm] and Nia blocks it with [Rockslide Elemental], which has four +1/+1 counters on it. Does Rockslide Elemental survive?
answer_gold:
Yes.

Rockslide Elemental has first strike, and deals 5 damage to Tephraderm in the first combat damage step. 

Tephraderm's ability triggers, but isn't put onto the stack until a player would gain priority next.

State-based actions are checked and Tephraderm dies due to having damage marked on it equal to its toughness. Rockslide Elemental's ability triggers. Both triggers are put onto the stack in APNAP order.

Nia's ability resolves first, as it was added to the stack last. When the stack is empty, Rockslide Elemental will have five +1/+1 counters and 5 damage.

question: Alessandra uses [Thunderheads] to create a token, and then casts [Rootborn Defenses] to populate the token. Will they have to exile the copy at the beginning of their next end step?
answer_gold: No. Populate just creates a copy of the token as it exists on the battlefield. The copiable values of the token are derived from those that would be directly printed on it if it were a card, so the condition that it must be exiled at the beginning of Alessandra's next end step is not copied.

question: Avery controls [Grip of Chaos] and casts [Murderous Cut]. Before that resolves they use [Kitsa, Otterball Elite] to copy Murderous Cut. Will Grip of Chaos trigger?
answer_gold: Yes, it triggers for the original spell and for the copy. When Avery copies Murderous Cut they will put it onto the stack, at which point Grip of Chaos will trigger.

question: Anika attacks with two different creatures. Nico activates [Forcefield]. When will Nico need to chose which creature Forcefield applies to?
answer_gold: Nico will need to choose a creature when Forcefield's ability resolves.

question: Angelique has [Copy Enchantment] enter the battlefield as a copy of [Estrid's Invocation], which is a copy of [Hardened-Scale Armor]. At the beginning of their next upkeep, which permanents may Angelique exile?
answer_gold:
Since both cards will have the ability, either Copy Enchantment and Estrid's Invocation may be exiled.

The copy effect of Estrid's Invocation includes the copy gaining an ability as part of the copying process. This is also a copiable value, and Copy Enchantment will also have this ability.

question: Ayden casts [Frozen in Ice] targeting their [Protean Thaumaturge]. Can they choose to have Protean Thaumaturge become a copy of their [Triton Shorethief]?
answer_gold: No. After an event occurs the game checks to see whether any trigger conditions were met. In this scenario, after Frozen in Ice resolves Protean Thaumaturge no longer has a triggered ability, and will not trigger.

question: Ari and Alianna are playing a game of Two-Headed Giant. Ari casts [Warbriar Blessing] targeting Alianna's [Nether Horror] and has it fight itself. Does Nether Horror die?
answer_gold: This can't happen as described. Ari cannot target Nether Horror with Warbriar Blessing as they must enchant a creature they control.

question: Avery casts [Dirge Bat] targeting [Dutiful Servants] to mutate unto it. Can Nevaeh cast [Withering Boon] to counter Dirge Bat?
answer_gold: Yes, Nevaeh can use Withering Boon to counter Dirge Bat if it was cast for the mutate cost. A spell that was cast for a mutate cost is still a creature spell and, therefore, can be countered by Withering Boon. ([702.140a])

question: Alex controls [Surrak Dragonclaw] and attacks with [Torbran, Thane of Red Fell]. Nick blocks with [Cliffhaven Sell-Sword]. What is the maximum amount of damage Alex can deal to Nick?
answer_gold: Three. When assigning combat damage, the game doesn't take into consideration any replacement effects that are modifying the damage. Alex must assign at least one damage to Cliffhaven Sell-Sword and the remaining damage to Nick. Afterwards the game applies Torbran, Thane of Red Fell's replacement effect and both Nick and Cliffhaven Sell-Sword are dealt three damage.

question: Aspen controls [Zirda, the Dawnwaker], [Sivitri Scarzam], and [Mobilized District]. How much does Aspen have to pay to activate the second ability of Mobilized District?
answer_gold:
Aspen can either pay {1} or {0}.

There are two effects that are reducing the cost of the second ability of Mobilized District. Because of this, Aspen can choose the order in which they will apply. If Aspen applies the reduction of effect from Mobilized District first then from Zirda, the Dawnwaker, Aspen will pay {1} because Zirda, the Dawnwaker can't reduce a cost to less than one mana. Alternatively, Aspen can apply the reduction from Zirda, the Dawnwaker first then from Mobilized District. This would require Aspen to spend {0} because the effect from Zirda, the Dawnwaker reduces the cost to {2} then the reduction for Mobilized District reduces it to {0}.

question: Nala controls [Phyrexian Revoker] naming [Merfolk Looter]. Addison casts [Archipelagore] choosing to mutate it onto Merfolk Looter placing Archipelagore on top. Can Addison activate the ability of the merged permanent?
answer_gold: Yes. When Addison mutates Archipelagore on top of Merfolk Looter the merged permanent will have the name of Archipelagore and will not be affected by Phyrexian Revoker. ([702.140a], [702.140e], [729.2a])

question: Angelica controls [Court of Grace] and [Vedalken Orrery]. At their first opportunity in their upkeep, they cast [Queen Marchesa]. When Court of Grace's triggered ability resolves, what happens?
answer_gold: Angelica creates a 4/4 white Angel token. Court of Grace's trigger does not have an intervening "if" clause, it just triggers at the beginning of all of Angelica's upkeeps and performs the specified actions when it resolves.

question: Ashley casts [Aminatou's Augury] exiling an artifact and an instant. Afterwards Ashley casts another Aminatou's Augury, which exiles an instant. Can they cast both instants?
answer_gold: Yes. Each Aminatou's Augury creates a separate effect that applies to cards it exiled. Casting an instant off the first Aminatou's Augury doesn't preclude Ashley from casting an instant off the second one.

question: Alia controls [Bag of Holding] and activates its first activated ability. When it resolves they draw a card and discard [Distemper of the Blood]. What happens?
answer_gold:
Alia can cast Distemper of the Blood. If they don't, it will either end up in exile or the graveyard, depending on the order in which they put the triggers on the stack.

When Distemper of the Blood is discarded, it's exiled instead of going to the graveyard. Alia can then choose in what order to put the triggers onto the stack. If the madness trigger resolves first and Alia doesn't cast it, it's put into their graveyard and then exiled to Bag of Holding. If the Bag of Holding trigger resolves first, it will do nothing since Distemper of the Blood is in exile. Then when the madness trigger resolves, if Alia doesn't cast it, it'll be moved to their graveyard.

question: Alexandra casts [Parting Thoughts] targeting Nico's [Dryad Militant]. In which zone is Parting Thoughts after resolution?
answer_gold: In Alexandra's graveyard. Putting Parting Thoughts into Alexandra's graveyard is the last part of its resolution. It therefore happens after Dryad Militant has already been destroyed and is no longer on the battlefield, its effect does not apply anymore.

question: Alexander has a [Gigapede] in their graveyard and one in their hand. How many times can Alexander trigger [Hashaton, Scarab's Fist]?
answer_gold: Once. Gigapede's triggered ability will go on the stack at the beginning of Alexander's upkeep, and once Alexander discards their second Gigapede it will no longer be the beginning of Alexander's upkeep. The second copy's ability won't trigger.

question: Avery has used [Control Magic] to gain control of Nathaniel's [Cosima, God of the Voyage]. Avery chooses to exile it at the beginning of their upkeep. Who controls the triggered ability it gains? And if that player chooses so when that ability resolves, under whose control would Cosima, God of the Voyage return?
answer_gold: The controller of the triggered ability is Cosima, God of the Voyage's owner: Nathaniel. It will trigger when they play a land, and if they choose to return Cosima, God of the Voyage to the battlefield, it will return under their control.

question: In a Commander game with 4 players, Ari casts [Kardur, Doomscourge]. Bode controls [Oxidda Finisher], and [Parhelion II], which is not a creature at the time Kardur, Doomscourge's enter the battlefield ability resolves. During Bode's next turn, can they attack Ari with Parhelion II? Can they have the Angel tokens created by Parhelion II attack Ari?
answer_gold:
Bode cannot attack Ari with Parhelion II, but they can choose for the Angel tokens to attack Ari.

Kardur, Doomscourge's enters-the-battlefield ability sets up a rules change that causes any creatures Ari's opponents control to have to attack if able and to have to attack another player if able. Since this is a change in the rules of the game, it affects Parhelion II even if it is not a creature at the time the ability resolves.

The Angel tokens are created attacking, but are never declared as attackers. Because of this, Bode can choose Ari to be the defending player for the tokens.

question: In a multiplayer game, can Braxton tap [Spectral Searchlight] to help Addison pay for Chaya's [Propaganda]?
answer_gold: No. When Addison attempts to attack Chaya with a creature, they will need to determine the cost to attack. After this is determined only the active player has the ability to activate mana abilities.

question: Alivia's commander is [Esika, God of the Tree]. Can they use mana produced by [Jeweled Lotus] to cast its other face, [The Prismatic Bridge]?
answer_gold: Yes. The commander designation is a property of the card itself, meaning both sides of the card are considered to be Alivia's commander.

question: Aubrey casts [Rescue the Foal] targeting their [Hazezon Tamar] in response to its enters-the-battlefield ability. What happens at the beginning of Aubrey's next upkeep?
answer_gold: Aubrey creates twice as many tokens as the number of lands they control. Hazezon Tamar's enters-the-battlefield ability has resolved twice, creating two instances of the delayed trigger ability creating tokens. One instance of Hazezon Tamar's leaves-the-battlefield ability has resolved, but did not do anything since at that time Aubrey did not control any Sand Warriors.

question: Aranza controls [Aluren] and has [Charred Graverobber] in their graveyard, as well as 5 other cards. Can they cast Charred Graverobber by paying no mana and exiling 5 cards?
answer_gold: No. Aluren's ability grants Aranza the ability to cast creature cards for an alternative cost, and casting Charred Graverobber for its Escape cost is also an alternative cost. ([702.138a], [118.9]). Players can't apply more than one alternative cost when casting a spell..

question: Alan casts [Rescue from the Underworld] sacrificing their commander, [Elektra, Daughter of the Hand], and choosing to return it to the command zone. Will Elektra, Daughter of the Hand return to the battlefield at the beginning of their next upkeep when Rescue from the Underworld's delayed trigger resolves?
answer_gold: No. When Elektra, Daughter of the Hand was sacrificed, it was first put into the graveyard and Alan chose to move it to the command zone from the graveyard as a state-based action. When it returns to the command zone it becomes a new object with no memory of its previous existence, so Rescue from the Underworld's delayed trigger won't be able to find it.

question: Aspen casts [Isochron Scepter]. Can they imprint [Revel in Silence] onto it? If so, which face(s) can Aspen cast?
answer_gold: Aspen cannot imprint Revel in Silence onto Isochron Scepter. Modal double-faced cards only have the characteristics of their front face in any zone other than the stack and the battlefield. The front face of Revel in Silence is a creature so it can't be imprinted on Isochron Scepter.

question: Autumn controls [Omnath, Locus of Creation] and [Yarok, the Desecrated]. Autumn plays a land. What happens?
answer_gold: Yarok, the Desecrated will cause Omnath, Locus of Creation to trigger twice, so Autumn will gain 4 life and add {R}{G}{W}{U}.

question: Anders casts [Hypothesizzle] targeting Norah's [Dryad Militant]. In which zone is Hypothesizzle after resolution?
answer_gold: In exile. Dryad Militant is destroyed only after Hypothesizzle finishes resolving, when state-based actions are checked.. It is therefore still on the battlefield when Hypothesizzle would be put in Anders's graveyard, as the last part of its resolution. Thus, its effect applies and exiles Hypothesizzle.

question: Ayla chooses to put a flood counter from [Quicksilver Fountain] onto their [Knight of New Benalia] which is currently enchanted by [Song of the Dryads]. What will the characteristics of Knight of New Benalia be if Song of the Dryads is destroyed?
answer_gold:
It's just a regular Knight of New Benalia with a flood counter. It's not a land, or an Island. Setting a land subtype does not add the land type, nor does it remove any other non-land types or subtypes from the card. While Knight of New Benalia is not a land, it also doesn't have the Island subtype. Losing all abilities and the ability to tap for {U} is as detailed in [305.7] only happens when setting a land's subtype, so that doesn't occur either.

No man is an Island.

question: Is [Umori, the Collector] a legal companion for a deck containing only [Grist, the Hunger Tide], creatures, and lands?
answer_gold: Yes. Grist, the Hunger Tide's ability is in effect even before the game begins..

question: Ahmed attacks with [Ebony Rhino]. Noemi declares no blocks and then casts [Dazzling Beauty] targeting Ebony Rhino. Is Ahmed able to assign Ebony Rhino's combat damage to Noemi?
answer_gold: Yes.

question: Armani controls [Dream Devourer] and foretells [Ghastly Gloomhunter]. If they cast it, can they pay the kicker? If so, what's the total cost?
answer_gold: Armani can pay kicker because it's an additional cost. Armani must pay a total f {3}{B}{B}, since its foretell cost is {B} and its kicker cost is {3}{B}.

question: Nico controls [Authority of the Consuls], and Alma casts [Gilder Bairn]. Can they activate its ability that turn?
answer_gold: No. "Summoning sickness" applies to both the {T} and {Q} symbols.

question: Ashley controls [Nightmare Shepherd] and [Clever Impersonator] which copied [Untethered Express] as it entered the battlefield. Clever Impersonator gets animated and then dies, triggers Nightmare Shepherd and Ashley chooses to use the ability. What happens?
answer_gold: Nightmare Shepherds trigger resolves and creates a token. That token will be an unanimated copy of Untethered Express, except it's a 1/1 and a nightmare. Notably, as it is currently not a creature, it will only be a 1/1 and a nightmare when crewed, since nightmare is a creature type but not an artifact type.

question: Addison controls [Harmonic Prodigy] and [Delver of Secrets], and has a sorcery on top of their library. What will happen during Addison's next upkeep?
answer_gold: Delver of Secrets's trigger will go on the stack twice. When the first trigger resolves, Addison can choose to reveal the top card of their library. If they do Delver of Secrets will transform. When the second trigger resolves, Addison can again reveal the instant or sorcery card, but if they do it won't transform again.

question: Augustine casts [Energy Tap] targeting their [Aclazotz, Deepest Betrayal]. Unfortunately, Aclazotz, Deepest Betrayal dies before Energy Tap resolves. What happens?
answer_gold: Augustine won't get any colorless mana. If a spell lacks targets when it goes to resolve, it won't do anything.

question: Autumn plays [Urborg, Tomb of Yawgmoth], then plays [Extraplanar Lens] exiling a basic [Swamp]. What lands can be tapped for additional mana?
answer_gold: Only basic Swamps will produce additional mana. Urborg, Tomb of Yawgmoth adds the basic land type "Swamp" to all lands on the battlefield, however, it doesn't change the names of those lands. Extraplanar Lens only affects lands with the same name as the exiled land.

question: Ayden casts [Sakashima the Impostor] copying their [Unlicensed Hearse], which is currently a 4/4. What is Sakashima the Impostor's power?
answer_gold:
Sakashima the Impostor won't be a creature. Copy effects copy only what is printed on the card (plus other copiable effects), not any other continuous effects that may be affecting it.

If Ayden activates Sakashima the Impostor's crew ability, it will be a 0/0.

question: Ainsley controls [Delver of Secrets] and uses [Ixidron] to try to turn it face down. What happens?
answer_gold: Nothing happens. Double-faced permanents can't be turned face down.

question: Aldo controls [Answered Prayers] and no other creatures. They cast [Wolfir Silverheart]. Can they pair it with Answered Prayers?
answer_gold: No. Soulbond is a triggered ability that will only go on the stack if Aldo controls another eligible creature when Wolfir Silverheart enters the battlefield. However before Answered Prayers's ability resolves, Aldo doesn't control any other eligible creatures.

question: Aubrey controls [Underworld Breach]. Can they dash [Flamerush Rider] from their graveyard?
answer_gold: No. Escape and dash are both alternative costs ([702.138a], [702.109a]), and only one alternative cost can be paid to cast a spell.

question: Nathaniel casts [The Wandering Emperor]. Avery then plays [Teferi, Time Raveler]. After it resolves, can Nathaniel activate The Wandering Emperor's abilities this turn?
answer_gold: Yes. Teferi, Time Raveler only prevents casting spells, not activating abilities.

question: Aaden controls [Nightshade Peddler] paired with an [Ojutai Monument] that's currently a creature. At the end of the turn, when Ojutai Monument stops being a creature, does it remain paired with Nightshade Peddler?
answer_gold: No. Paired creatures only remain paired for as long as they are both creatures.

question: Ariel is at 1 life, controls [City of Brass], and has [Angel's Grace] in their hand. Can they tap City of Brass for {W} and then use that {W} to cast Angel's Grace and not lose the game?
answer_gold: Yes. When Ariel taps City of Brass, the trigger to deal 1 damage is put onto the stack.Ariel may cast Angel's Grace before it resolves.

question: Aaliyah and Aarush are on a team in a game of Two-Headed Giant that is just beginning. Aaliyah wants to mulligan. Can Aarush wait to see what Aaliyah draws in their next hand before deciding whether to mulligan?
answer_gold: No. Both team members must mulligan at the same time.

question: Autumn controls a [Perilous Landscape] and [Omen Machine], whose trigger reveals [Brink of Disaster]. Nikolai controls [Grand Arbiter Augustin IV]. What will happen as the trigger resolves?
answer_gold: Casting a spell without paying its mana cost is an alternative cost, and the additional cost from Grand Arbiter Augustin IV will still apply to it. Autumn is required to cast Brink of Disaster, but if they're unable to pay the costs of the spell, it remains in its previous zone. Autumn is not required to tap the Perilous Landscape for mana.

question: Aydan has searched their library this turn with [Aang's Journey]. During their end step, Nathaly casts [Mission Briefing]. Can they use it to cast [Archive Trap] from their graveyard for free?
answer_gold: Yes. Mission Briefing allows Nathaly to cast Archive Trap from their graveyard, without any other restrictions on how it's cast. Nathaly can choose to pay the alternative cost of {0}.

question: Ace casts [Hour of Promise], finding [Vesuva] and [Accursed Duneyard]. Can Vesuva copy Accursed Duneyard?
answer_gold: No. The choice of what Vesuva can copy is made before it enters the battlefield, and Accursed Duneyard isn't on the battlefield yet at that time.

question: Aliza sacrifices [Lembas] to gain life. Can Nasir exile it in response with [Cling to Dust]?
answer_gold: Yes. That ability is a triggered ability which goes onto the stack and can be responded to.

question: Arian controls [Spiteful Visions] and draws [Redress Fate] for turn. Can they see what they're drawing from Spiteful Visions before deciding whether to cast Redress Fate for miracle?
answer_gold: Yes. Arian must reveal Redress Fate as they draw it, but they don't cast it right away; revealing it puts a trigger onto the stack to cast it later. Spiteful Visions's trigger is put onto the stack at the same time, so Arian can choose which one resolves first. If they don't want to cast Redress Fate when the miracle trigger resolves, they don't have to.

question: Ainsley controls [Kaervek, the Spiteful] and casts [White Sun's Twilight] with X=5. What happens?
answer_gold: Kaervek, the Spiteful is destroyed and Ainsley controls five 1/1 Phyrexian Mite artifact creature tokens. Kaervek, the Spiteful is destroyed and the Mites are created during the resolution of White Sun's Twilight. A creature dying due to having 0 toughness is a state-based action, and state-based actions are checked whenever a player would get priority. Players do not get priority during the resolution of a spell, so by the time state-based actions are checked, Kaervek, the Spiteful is no longer on the battlefield.

question: Amelie controls [Nissa, Resurgent Animist] and [Elesh Norn, Mother of Machines]. Amelie plays a land, then casts [Urban Evolution] and plays another land. How many Elves/Elementals will they get to look for in total?
answer_gold: Just one. Elesh Norn, Mother of Machines makes Nissa, Resurgent Animist trigger a total of four times, but only one of those triggers can be the second one.

question: Angelo casts [Deny Reality], cascading into [Living End]. Living End brings back Angelo's [God-Eternal Rhonas] and Nico's [The Earth King]. Which enters-the-battlefield trigger resolves first?
answer_gold: The Earth King's. Triggers are put onto the stack in turn order, and the stack resolves from the top down, so the non-active player's triggers resolve first.

question: Alessandra controls [Sheoldred, the Apocalypse]. During their main phase, they cast [Day's Undoing]. How much life does each player gain/lose?
answer_gold: None. The players first draw seven cards each, triggering Sheoldred, the Apocalypse fourteen times. Then Alessandra ends the turn, which nullifies those triggers before they're even put onto the stack.

question: Avery has 1 life and controls [Mana Confluence]. Can they cast [Angel's Grace] without losing the game? If so, what will their resulting life total be?
answer_gold: No, Avery would lose the game. Mana Confluence pays the life as a cost to activate the ability. If Avery taps Mana Confluence before casting Angel's Grace, they'll die before they can begin to cast Angel's Grace. If they begin casting Angel's Grace and activate Mana Confluence while casting the spell, they'll lose the game when state-based actions are checked after they're done casting Angel's Grace, before it resolves.

question: Ainsley controls [Omnath, Locus of Creation] and [Elesh Norn, Mother of Machines]. They play [Desert of the Indomitable]. What happens?
answer_gold: Omnath, Locus of Creation's ability triggers twice. The first instance of the ability will cause Ainsley to gain 4 life and the second instance will add {R}{G}{U}{W} to their mana pool. Elesh Norn, Mother of Machines will cause the ability to trigger twice since it triggers as the result of a permanent entering the battlefield. Omnath, Locus of Creation's triggered ability has an effect depending on how many times its resolved this turn, so the second instance that resolves will have the second effect.

question: Ainsley casts [Superior Spider-Man] but before it resolves Noelle casts [Humility]. Can Ainsley choose to copy something?
answer_gold: Superior Spider-Man won't enter as a copy of anything. As Superior Spider-Man is entering the battlefield the game checks to see what it would look like on the battlefield to see if any replacement effects would apply to it. Because Humility is on the battlefield, Superior Spider-Man wouldn't have any replacement effects, and therefore Ainsley doesn't get to choose to copy anything.

question: Ainsley controls [Conspicuous Snoop] and no other permanents. The top two cards of their library are [Skirk Prospector], can they cast one?
answer_gold: Yes. The game doesn't check whether the spell is legal to cast after Ainsley has the opportunity to activate mana abilities and pay costs, therefore they can sacrifice Conspicuous Snoop to pay for Skirk Prospector.

question: Ashley attacks Nayeli with [Gutter Skulk] and [Elvish Warrior]. Nayeli casts [Deflecting Palm], choosing Ashley's Gutter Skulk as it resolves. Both players are at 2 life. What happens?
answer_gold: The game ends in a draw. Deflecting Palm deals damage to Ashley immediately after Elvish Warrior deals damage to Nayeli. The next time state-based actions are checked, both players are at 0 life and lose at the same time, making the game a draw.

question: Ashley attacks with [Krallenhorde Killer]. Nickolas blocks with an animated [Mishra's Factory]. Can they tap it after blockers are declared to give itself +1/+1?
answer_gold: Yes.

question: Avery controls [The One Ring] and casts [Teferi's Protection] then casts a second The One Ring. What happens at the start of the next turn?
answer_gold: The One Ring will phase back in during the untap step. Then all triggered abilities will go onto the stack, then before Avery gets priority they will have to sacrifice a The One Ring to state-based actions. When the triggers resolve the trigger affiliated with the sacrificed The One Ring will use last known information to determine how many counters were on it, and how much life Avery should lose.

question: Avery controls [Living Plane] and plays [Minas Tirith]. Does it enter tapped or untapped?
answer_gold: Tapped. When applying an enters-the-battlefield replacement effect, the game considers the characteristics of the permanent as it would exist on the battlefield, so it sees that it would be a creature, but it doesn't consider the permanent to actually be on the battlefield yet. Effectively, a legendary creature is entering the battlefield.

question: Ariel activates the [-2] ability of [Grist, the Hunger Tide], intending to sacrifice their 1/1 Insect token to destroy Nicholas's [Multani's Acolyte]. Can Nicholas kill the Insect in order to save their Multani's Acolyte?
answer_gold: Yes, but only before knowing that Multani's Acolyte is the target. When Ariel activates Grist, the Hunger Tide, Nicholas can respond by killing the Insect. If Ariel doesn't sacrifice a creature when Grist, the Hunger Tide's ability resolves, there won't be any trigger to destroy a creature or planeswalker. But once that trigger is on the stack targeting Multani's Acolyte, the Insect is already in the graveyard.

question: Ainsley uses [Living End] to return both [Breathless Knight] and [Lantern Kami] from their graveyard to the battlefield. How many +1/+1 counters will Breathless Knight get?
answer_gold: Zero. Living End exiles the cards from the graveyard before putting them on the battlefield, and Breathless Knight only gets counters if it entered from a graveyard.

question: Amirah has [Rockalanche] in their graveyard and activates [Lion's Eye Diamond] to pay for it. After Amirah activates their Lion's Eye Diamond does Nehemiah have a chance to cast [Surgical Extraction] on Rockalanche?
answer_gold: No. Nehemiah can only cast a spell when they have priority. Lion's Eye Diamond is a mana ability and as such resolves immediately. Which means priority will not pass to Nehemiah, and Amirah can then cast Rockalanche from their graveyard.

question: Azariah controls [Roaming Throne] naming "Elf", and then casts [Elvish Warmaster], what happens?
answer_gold: Azariah will get one Elf token. When Elvish Warmaster enters the battlefield its ability triggers and Roaming Throne attempts to cause the trigger to happen a second time, however because there's a restriction on the amount of times Elvish Warmaster's ability can trigger, it simply won't happen.
